in_marathi.name: Romila
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Female form of Rama, God of love and protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Romila हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Romila is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rama', which means 'God of love and protection'. In Hindu mythology, Rama is an avatar of the god Vishnu and is known for his unwavering devotion to his wife, Sita, and his unwavering commitment to righteousness. The feminine form of Rama is Romila, and it is believed that this name bestows upon the bearer the qualities of love, protection, and devotion.
